title: Mail Memories – A desktop app to rescue photos from Gmail

zh.gap: Takeout 给的是归档格式，不是相册；Google Photos 只知道你刻意上传过的东西，看不见你 2011 年发给自己的那张扫描件。缺的是最后一公里的拆包，不是导出。中文侧同一批照片在 QQ邮箱和微信文件传输助手里，完全没有人管。
zh.pain: 这个人手里还剩的家庭照片，有一大部分只以附件形式存在，散在几千封信里，而那正是没人会去翻照片的地方。他知道照片在里面。他试过一次，拿到一个 .mbox，关掉了。
zh.kill: 这是一次性活儿——打开一次，再也不开——没有留存也没有订阅，而 Google 只要在 Takeout 里加一个「照片」勾选框就永久关闭它。它还必须索取邮箱权限，那是普通人最不愿意给的一项，而索取的理由是一件对方一辈子只会做一次的事。
zh.move: 把「只在本地」做成产品本身而不是脚注：只读、不联网，交付物是一个能直接拖进手机相册的文件夹，外加一张可打印的「出现次数最多的十张脸」联系表——是成品，于是这件一次性的活儿以一件留得下来的东西结束。定价一次性，不做月费。冷启动（中文）：小红书／豆瓣「邮箱 老照片 找回」「换手机 照片丢了」；（英文）：r/DataHoarder 与 r/gmail 里反复出现的「怎么把十年的附件从 Gmail 里弄出来」那条帖。
zh.hook: 同一个邮箱用了十五年的人，刚意识到一场出生、一场葬礼、以及父亲当年扫描过来的一张纸，只存在于一个地方：邮件附件里。Google Takeout 回给他一个 .mbox，全家没人打得开。
zh.does: 在本地读你的邮箱，把里面的照片挑出来，排成一本真能打开的相册。
zh.consumer_angle: 一个普通邮箱用户，最后手机里多了一个家庭照片文件夹，手上多了一张印出来的、最重要那几张脸的联系表。

gap: Takeout delivers an archive format, not an album; Google Photos only knows what you deliberately uploaded and cannot see the scan you emailed yourself in 2011. The missing piece is the last-mile unpacking, not the export. On the Chinese side the same photographs are in QQ邮箱 and 微信文件传输助手, and nothing addresses that at all.
pain: A large share of the family photographs this person still owns exist only as attachments, scattered across thousands of messages, in the one place nobody browses for pictures. They know the photos are in there. They have tried once, got a .mbox, and closed it.
kill: It is a one-time job — opened once, never again — so there is no retention and no subscription, and Google closes it forever by adding a single 'photos' checkbox to Takeout. It also has to ask for mailbox access, the permission ordinary people are most reluctant to grant, and it is asking for it to do something they will only ever do once.
move: Make local-only the product rather than a footnote: read-only, no network, and the deliverable is a folder you can drag straight into a phone gallery plus a printable contact sheet of the ten faces that appear most — an artefact, so the one-time job ends in something they keep. Price it once, not monthly. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书/豆瓣 「邮箱 老照片 找回」「换手机 照片丢了」; (English): the 'how do I get ten years of attachments out of Gmail' thread that recurs in r/DataHoarder and r/gmail.
hook: Someone who has used the same mailbox for fifteen years and has just realised that a birth, a funeral and a scan their father posted them exist in exactly one place: as email attachments. Google Takeout hands back a .mbox that nobody in the family can open.
does: Reads a mailbox locally and pulls out the photographs, sorting them into an album you can actually open.
consumer_angle: An ordinary mailbox owner ends up with a folder of family photographs on their phone and a printed sheet of the faces that mattered.
